cfg.itemcontrol.item.prot.list.tooltip: §eFormat: Identifier;FireImmune;ExplosionImmune;Glowing;NoGravity. §aIdentifiers support item IDs, #tags, @mods, and optional components after an item ID; the four flags must be true or false.
gui.itemcontrol.tabs.tabs.unified.toolti: Shift+Right Click: Toggle components match mode
cfg.itemcontrol.tabs.tabs.open_editor.to: §aSupports single items, components items, #item tags, @mod namespaces, hidden tabs, and item additions. §eThe server validates tabs, items, and components before saving.
gui.itemcontrol.item_property.add_rule.t: Select an item to add a rule. In Drop Protection, you can also enter #namespace:tag, @modid, or item_id[components] in Search, then click Add Rule.
gui.itemcontrol.item_property.category.t: Choose a property group. Drop Protection includes all items and supports item tags, mods, and components rules.
cfg.itemcontrol.item_property.restart_no: Apply item and accessory changes immediately on save; enchantability on 26.1.2 requires a restart.
gui.itemcontrol.item_property.restart_hi: Apply immediately on save; 26.1.2 enchantability requires a restart.
gui.itemcontrol.item_property.reset_item: Clear the overrides for this item. Save to apply the reset. Enchantability on 26.1.2 requires a restart.
gui.itemcontrol.item_property.save.toolt: Save and apply rules, including held and equipped attribute changes. The editor stays open. Enchantability on 26.1.2 requires a restart.
msg.itemcontrol.item_property.saved_appl: Saved and applied. 26.1.2 enchantability needs a restart.
